commits.message:
Add expandable inline sub-pathway for branch nodes in SkillPathway

- Each branch card in the fork lane now shows a ▸/▾ expand toggle when the branch skill has its own companions
- Expanding reveals the branch's downstream chain (up to 5 steps) inline below the fork lane, using a teal-tinted, steel-bordered sub-track to distinguish it from the primary chain
- Collapsing restores the compact fork lane
- Added buildForwardPath() to search.ts — walks forward from an arbitrary skill root without backward root-finding, used for sub-pathway computation
- Hint text updated to mention the ▸ toggle
- SkillPathway now accepts allSkills prop passed through from SkillDetail
